report:
Fresh independent reassessment of complete meta.reviews.input_fragments claim after source changes. All requirements are addressed: automatically prepared, coordinator-supplied and reviewer-declared source context share a uniform collection; helpers and surrounding context must be captured beyond initial claims/tests; automatic and additional fragments share representation and freshness checks; dependency completeness is reviewer-declared. There is one ordinary implementation association and four ordinary tests, with no TODO/N/A evidence.

Implementation inspection: the supplied complete review.rs is unchanged from my earlier inspected source. ReviewInput.fragments is Vec<InputFragment>. inventory constructs the claim, whole implementation files and complete test functions using source_lines; capture_read selects declared context, appends the same InputFragment representation and saves it before returning text. input_errors verifies the initial inventory prefix and reselects every appended fragment with exact string equality. Both record and acceptance/checking paths apply these checks. The origin of a source fragment does not bypass validation. Coordinator source context uses the same declared-read mechanism, while free-form instructions are preserved separately as instructions. PROMPT and the captured review skill explicitly impose dependency declaration; the claim deliberately assigns this responsibility to the reviewer instead of promising automatic surveillance of uncaptured reads.

Complete associated test assessment: initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments asserts exact returned/saved input equality; exact claim, whole implementation and selected-test text; correct paths/selectors and instruction preservation. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection asserts every implementation/test metadata field, unchanged original fragment prefix and metadata after a helper read, precisely one appended fragment, exact helper content and the five JSON fields. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits asserts exact range/whole helper text including CRLF and missing final newline, appended duplicate fragment equality, selected-edit rejection and acceptance of edits outside the selected range; changing a captured whole-file trailing newline invalidates review. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review changes an automatically captured implementation and asserts failed recording, unchanged saved input and failing checking; it also covers invalid reports and requested edits. Together these assertions cover initial and additional source representation and freshness, resolving the former association gap. No redundant test is needed for each input origin because all use the identical fragment model and read/validation mechanisms. No production defect or unresolved scenario found.

Captured additional dependencies are tests/review.rs lines 1-104 (Fixture setup/readback/report helpers), the review skill and full review specification. Fresh associated tests were read in full and compared with current implementation, not approved from names or prior verdicts. Earlier draft findings only guided the reassessment; they were not treated as evidence. No Rust source was edited. Personally executed review start/read and the final recording command; did not independently rerun functional tests or build. Coordinator separately reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests and workspace build passed; those are external execution reports, not commands I executed. All aspects are accounted for and no edits are requested.

Refresh assessment: fresh start under /tmp/sage-refresh-8.txt and comparison of every current initial fragment confirms the complete claim and implementation are unchanged, as are all four test bodies. The only initial fragment changes are an additional record_required association on invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review and a source_representation association on whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits. These do not alter their assertions or this claim coverage. Recaptured Fixture through its exact closing line 104; helper contents remain unchanged. The earlier range included unrelated following test attributes, which caused avoidable staleness; the refreshed bounded dependency includes every relied-on helper and no following test. Recaptured skill/specification are also unchanged. Reassessed the prior rationale against current saved fragments; complete-set representation, append preservation and freshness coverage still support approval. No source edits or broad tests performed in this refresh.
